# MyTestType

MyTestType is a cultural entertainment service with four active experiences:

- AI past-life character test: https://mytesttype.com/
- AI face-reading guide and test: https://mytesttype.com/gwansang/
- AI palm-reading guide and test: https://mytesttype.com/palm-reading/
- K-Shaman AI Saju: https://mytesttype.com/k-shaman/

Search-intent guides:

- Past life and Joseon occupations: https://mytesttype.com/guide/past-life/
- Face reading and facial impressions: https://mytesttype.com/guide/face/
- Palm lines and palm-reading photos: https://mytesttype.com/guide/palm/
- Saju and birth-date readings: https://mytesttype.com/guide/saju/

Results are cultural and entertainment-oriented references, not scientific,
medical, financial, legal, or guaranteed predictions.
